policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: Dismissible Smart Refresh notices add a state-watermarked dismissal latch, an additive active-server ShowNotices policy, accessible dual actions, and presentation-only suppression in core/live-update.ts. The legitimate core scope increase is 29 instrumented lines (2637→2666); compatibility, dismissal/retry/re-arm, live suppression, Ask-mode regressions, and download lifecycle regressions raise the reviewed high-water by 30 covered lines (2295→2325, 87.209%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 full-suite coverage runs on 2026-07-25 each passed all 1524 tests across 223 files and reproduced exactly 2325/2666. Retaining the one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2324/2666 (87.172%), stricter than both the prior 2295/2637 high-water percentage (87.031%) and its 2294/2637 tolerated floor (86.993%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The server-owned download lifecycle feature adds bounded Sonarr/Radarr queue and history paging, deterministic O(q+h) reconciliation and normalization, stable persisted instance identity (including pre-edit legacy migration), user/library/Seerr authorization, fail-closed partial-source envelopes, bounded ARR response streaming, Manage-status normalization, configuration controls, and policy-aware recursive allowlisted Seerr download-status projection. The legitimate complete-assembly scope increase is 2001 instrumented lines (28605→30606); focused lifecycle, pagination, transport, identity, authorization, privacy, configuration, concurrency, and boundary regressions raise the reviewed high-water by 1847 covered lines (20200→22047, 72.035%). Two clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-25 each passed all 1926 tests and measured 22046 or 22047 covered lines out of 30606, establishing 22047 as the reviewed high-water. Retaining the evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 22042/30606 (72.019%), stricter than both the prior 20195/28605 tolerated floor (70.600%) and the prior 20200/28605 high-water (70.617%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
